title: How a Volcano Builds an Island From Nothing
board: Hook: the island today, a canoe arrives
"Let's rewind": the forest vanishes, time runs back
Back to day 1: the empty, dark sea floor
Jellies drift; hot rock rises below
The sea floor cracks and glows
Pillow lava: toothpaste in ice water
A crab falls asleep on the lava
Thousands of years: fish, the mountain climbs
A whale passes; 4 km tall and growing
The sea boils; the crab wakes
Steam and ash blast through the waves
New land breaks the surface
First sunlight: the island smiles
A coconut sprouts; a spider balloons in
A bird drops a seed; green spreads
Rain, waterfalls, valleys
Forest, and a canoe arrives
Night: a camp fire, the summit glow
Pull back: the island chain drifts away
The next island, already growing
